comparison.objective: Unwrap a grazing tether from a post by carrying its collar around against the wrap, then place the collar in a white circle.
comparison.physical_skill: Reason about cable topology and transport a tether endpoint around an obstacle; candidate uses localized coaxial tooling, impacts and tiny rigid-fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Tether unwrapped and blue collar left in the target circle; tension, snag and final-clearance thresholds are missing. Candidate requires four fractures with no loss or damage.
comparison.reason: Topology-changing tether manipulation is a different tested ability and outcome.
